name: brewpage-publish
description: Host HTML pages and static sites, publish AI artifacts, and share Markdown, documents, reports or any file with BrewPage.

interface.shortDescription: Host HTML, static sites and AI artifacts; share any file.
interface.longDescription: Host HTML pages and static sites, publish AI artifacts, and share Markdown, documents, reports or any file with BrewPage.

skillInstructions: MCP-FIRST NATIVE OVERRIDE: Use the bundled skill as workflow guidance and publish only through the BrewPage MCP tools. Never execute bundled scripts/brewpage-run.sh, scripts/publish.mjs or any other shell helper; never expand CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR or rely on Claude runtime variables. Claude tool names Read, Bash, Glob and AskUserQuestion, allowed-tools and model metadata grant no Kimi capabilities or permissions. Translate AskUserQuestion into an explicit question to the user. Obtain explicit namespace and password choices before every publication; silence is not consent. Inspect only content the user supplies for publication. If MCP cannot perform a required operation, stop and explain the unsupported operation rather than falling back to shell helpers. This override supersedes ALL bundled Claude history, storage and output instructions, including Step 7. Never read or write Claude configuration or history, including .claude/brewpage-history.md. Never repeat the original Step 7 owner-token-saved line. After publishing give the user the reader URL and the management link the MCP tool returned, and say the management link is private: anyone who has it can edit or delete the page. Claim an owner token was saved ONLY after evidence confirms native private storage; otherwise give the token to the user with the same privacy note and say it was not persisted. Show a stored owner token when the user asks. Never post the management link, the owner token or other secrets publicly (public page, repo, shared channel). These are agent instructions, not an enforced sandbox; model compliance and native private storage remain unverified.
